_: Which pack each vanilla biome of the layout is generated from. 'order': the first provider in this list that ships the biome for 26.3 wins ('vanilla' always has it), so a newer Overrealm that covers more biomes takes them over from Geophilic by itself. 'biomes': exceptions, e.g. {"minecraft:taiga": "vanilla"}. 'drop_features': placed features (fnmatch patterns) taken out of the provider biomes because they cannot work on the islands; the reasons are in 'drop_reasons'. See README.md, 'Biome packs'.

drop_reasons.orealm:sequence/jellyfish: floats 4 to 15 blocks above a sea floor; the sea basins have no water yet
drop_reasons.orealm:spring/ocean_caves: 64 water springs per chunk meant for flooded ocean caves: in a dry basin they run through the caves and pour out of the island's underside (seen as water columns under d5 and M5)
